settings.visualStyle: Grounded cinematic first-person WWII Mediterranean realism during the Sicily landings, July 1943. U.S. Army infantry POV, rough surf, pale sand, dry stone walls, olive groves, dust, heat and inland farm tracks. Non-graphic and historically grounded.
settings.customProjectStructure: 15 scenes x 8 seconds. No spoken dialogue, narrator or intelligible speech. Nearby friendlies remain U.S. Army. Axis forces remain clearly separate in opposing inland positions. Balance surf, heat, farm terrain, short danger and quiet recovery.
settings.customVisualStyle: Photorealistic first-person Mediterranean invasion reenactment with salt water, sun glare, dust, stone textures, olive shade and natural body motion.

movie.storyTitle: WWII Soldier POV EP13 — Sicily: From Surf to Olive Groves
movie.storySummary: A fictional U.S. soldier lands on Sicily, moves off the beach through stone walls and olive groves, survives brief distant fire and reaches a shaded inland position by late afternoon.
movie.mainStoryPrompt: Use Mediterranean heat, glare, dust and terrain as the main experience. No dialogue or narration.

scenes.title: Landing Craft Heat
scenes.actionDescription: He grips hot metal rail as Sicily approaches.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person U.S. Army sleeve, landing craft rail, bright coast ahead, rifle slung.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow coast reveal. Audio: engine, waves, gear, breath.

scenes.title: Into the Surf
scenes.actionDescription: He steps into waist-deep water and pushes toward shore.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person surf, wet uniform, U.S. troops ahead, bright beach.
scenes.videoPrompt: Heavy wading. Audio: splashing, surf, breath.

scenes.title: Dry Sand
scenes.actionDescription: He climbs from wet sand to dry dune edge.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person wet boots into pale sand, rifle low, scrub ahead.
scenes.videoPrompt: Short uphill push. Audio: sand, gear, distant artillery.

scenes.title: Stone Wall
scenes.actionDescription: He crouches behind low dry-stone wall and catches breath.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person hand on pale stone, sea behind, friendly soldiers nearby.
scenes.videoPrompt: Drop into cover and still. Audio: wind, breath, distant battle.

scenes.title: Salt on Sleeve
scenes.actionDescription: He wrings seawater from one cuff.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person wet sleeve over dusty stone, rifle resting beside wall.
scenes.videoPrompt: Quiet close detail. Audio: fabric, wind, distant guns.

scenes.title: Farm Lane
scenes.actionDescription: He follows squad along narrow lane between stone walls.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person dusty lane, olive trees, U.S. infantry ahead.
scenes.videoPrompt: Steady walking. Audio: boots, cicadas, gear.

scenes.title: Distant Fire
scenes.actionDescription: Distant rounds strike dust farther down lane and he ducks behind wall.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person stone wall cover, dust puffs in opposing direction, no enemy mixed with friendlies.
scenes.videoPrompt: Quick duck. Audio: distant cracks, dust, breath.

scenes.title: Wait in Shade
scenes.actionDescription: He waits under olive branches, rifle low, listening.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person olive leaves overhead, dappled shade, dusty gloves.
scenes.videoPrompt: Near-still listening beat. Audio: cicadas, wind, distant battle.

scenes.title: Canteen Under Olives
scenes.actionDescription: He drinks and wipes salt from lips.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person canteen, olive shade, weapon off-frame.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow drink. Audio: cicadas, swallow, breath.

scenes.title: Village Edge
scenes.actionDescription: He enters a quiet village edge behind squad.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person pale stucco walls, shutters, empty lane, U.S. troops ahead.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow approach. Audio: boots, distant dogs, wind.

scenes.title: Doorway Pause
scenes.actionDescription: He leans in shaded doorway and checks dusty hands.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person cool doorway shadow, dusty fingers, bright street outside.
scenes.videoPrompt: Still contrast between shadow and sun. Audio: breath, cicadas.

scenes.title: Hill Road
scenes.actionDescription: He climbs an inland dirt road as the coast falls behind.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person dusty uphill track, olive groves, coast distant.
scenes.videoPrompt: Uphill walking. Audio: boots, wind, gear.

scenes.title: Coast Behind
scenes.actionDescription: He turns back briefly toward landing beaches.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person wide Mediterranean coast, ships offshore, dusty sleeve foreground.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow turn to coast reveal. Audio: wind, distant artillery.

scenes.title: Olive Shade Again
scenes.actionDescription: He sits under tree and removes helmet briefly.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person hands holding helmet, sweat-dark hairline implied, olive branches above.
scenes.videoPrompt: Quiet helmet removal and breath. Audio: cicadas, wind.

scenes.title: Road Inland
scenes.actionDescription: He replaces helmet and follows squad farther inland.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person dusty road, U.S. soldiers ahead, warm late light.
scenes.videoPrompt: Steady forward walk. Audio: boots, cicadas, tired breath. Fade.

characters.name: POV Soldier
characters.description: Anonymous U.S. infantryman during Operation Husky in Sicily, 1943.
characters.mainOutfit: U.S. Army field uniform, M1 helmet, web gear, service rifle

continuity.continuityRules: Nearby friendlies remain U.S. Army. Axis forces remain clearly separate. Preserve wet-to-dry clothing transition, dust, heat and fatigue.
